title: Verification coverage baseline: November 2026
interpretation: Unassigned HRL and zero confirmed HRL4+ mean insufficient evidence reviewed under these gates; they do not establish that no such deployments exist. This editorial cohort is not a statistical sample, and its counts cannot be generalized to the sector.
limitations: A source review is not an independent audit.
Not established means absent or unresolved in the inspected sources, not absent everywhere.
A product-page claim remains V1 even when the page calls a section Technical Specifications.
Existing catalogue values are preserved; this overlay does not silently replace the data source.
HRL assessments cover only their named source-backed activity. No HRL4+, rated-load duty cycle or independent physical audit is claimed.
next_report: A quarterly comparison requires another dated evidence review; this launch baseline does not claim a completed quarter.
